title: The crossroad Part 2
author: Asjad Ullah
description: Mia wants to exploit a pre-marriage contract with her millionaire husband, Jones. She sets him up, so she could grab all his wealth, and enjoy life with her boyfriend Dan. But things go out of control, leaving everyone flabbergasted!

messages.text: Someone your wife, Mia, just paid a 100 grand.
To have an affair with you.
I have a plan that will turn the tables on her.
Why are you telling me all this?
Your wife just paid 30 grand of the total amount.
And I’m not too confident she will pay the remaining sum.
I wouldn’t say this if I were you.
I know you’ve signed a contract with your wife.
The one who is caught cheating...gives up everything.
And if I’m not mistaken, she has a large chunk of your estate.
All I’m saying is, what if you catch her cheating?
First I’ll have to find a guy; then frame her.
You don’t have to find a guy.
You just need to find “the” guy.
Yeah, and I’m already in contact with him.
And I can get all the evidence for the courts.
Why should I trust a woman like you?
You don’t have a choice dear.
The clock is ticking, Jones darling!
150 grand is peanuts compared to her estate.
I know her plan now, you’re exposed.
Now which ones you want me to send you?
You don’t have anything against me.
I’ve compromising pictures of you having fun.
Which ones would you like to see?
Oh God! I should have known.
